name: Barrett Price
strengths: Price sells stems on outs and digs, then finds soft coverage pockets instead of running blind routes.
Price tracks contested throws with body control — adjusts mid-air and secures through contact.
Price creates after the catch with vision and balance once he gets north-south.
weaknesses: Price still refining elite route precision and separation consistency as he adds juice to the 6-0 / 175 frame.
comparison: Price comps to Jordan Addison — 5-11 / 6-0 sudden WR mold; creates with route sharpness, tracks on the perimeter, and turns timing throws into chunk gains.
projection: Price projects as a Year 2–3 perimeter contributor (scout/special teams Year 1). Ceiling: starting outside/slot WR — the Spain Park separator who grows into an SEC perimeter role.
schemeFit: Price fits Faulkner perimeter concepts that reward stem discipline, awareness, and contested catch toughness.
staffNotes: Vault film desk re-verified 2026-08-21 from Spain Park Hudl. Comp size-matched to Jordan Addison band (within 1–2").
insiderNotes: Price is a sudden perimeter receiver who wins with route detail, awareness, tracking, and contested toughness. Creates YAC with vision once secured — more technician than pure burner. Unranked (0★) this early in the 2028 cycle is board timing, not a red flag — Florida offered on tape traits and the June UOV process, not a public star count.
recruitingStory: Why Florida offered Barrett Price despite an unranked On3 board: early-cycle 2028 rankings lag what staff see on Spain Park tape. Price is a 6-0 / 175 technician — stems, soft-pocket awareness, contested body control, YAC vision — the mold Marcus Davis plants a flag on before the industry catches up. Florida leads RPM (~28%) after the June 19 UOV; offer = process start, not a finished ranking story.
angle: Quiet why: Florida offered Price on tape + visit process while the 2028 board is still blank — not because stars already say so.
